# IThrownFireball.HitboxScale property

How big the hitbox is, as a multiple of the game's, 42 units wide and high: 1 when thrown. It keeps its bottom center, where the ball rests and its drawing hangs. Set it to [`Scale`](./Scale.md) to have the hitbox match the drawing.

```csharp
public float HitboxScale { get; set; }
```
